description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the @resciencelab/declaw package and its tool API. (2) Apply the TOFU rule — call p2p_add_peer('200:b33f:cafe:dead::7', 'NordsternPrimary') BEFORE any p2p_send_message call. (3) Call p2p_send_message with the exact message text AND explicit port=9055 (not the default 8099) — a naive agent unaware of the skill will use the default port. (4) When the first send returns a timeout/failure, call yggdrasil_check() before retrying — this is a proprietary error-handling rule not obvious from general knowledge. (5) Retry p2p_send_message after yggdrasil_check, achieving successful delivery. The script must use require('@resciencelab/declaw') and call all functions in the correct order per the SKILL.md rules.
